cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-open-mounts-and-close-releases
cases.purpose: Opening mounts the chat list and connection status; closing releases the client.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-select-chat-loads-history
cases.purpose: Selecting a chat loads and shows its recent messages.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-composer-sends-and-clears-on-ack
cases.purpose: The in-layout composer sends typed text and clears it only after acceptance.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-draft-survives-until-ack
cases.purpose: An unacknowledged send keeps the draft text for retry.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-chat-keys-move-the-selection
cases.purpose: The next and previous chat keys move the selected conversation.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-live-message-appends-to-the-open-chat
cases.purpose: A message arriving while a chat is open is appended after the loaded history.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-live-message-deduplicates-by-id
cases.purpose: Delivering the same message twice still shows one copy.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-live-copy-of-the-draft-keeps-it-until-ack
cases.purpose: Another client's copy of the draft text does not clear the draft; only the send acknowledgement does.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-first-and-last-chat-commands
cases.purpose: The first and last chat commands jump to the ends of the conversation list.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-message-keys-move-the-selection
cases.purpose: Selecting a chat selects its newest message and the n/p keys move the selection.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-reply-quotes-the-selected-message
cases.purpose: Replying to the selected message sends the text with its quote and clears the mode.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-edit-replaces-the-selected-message
cases.purpose: Editing the selected outgoing message prefills the composer, replaces the text and marks it edited.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-cancel-edit-restores-the-draft
cases.purpose: Cancelling an edit restores the draft captured before editing began.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-delete-removes-the-selected-message
cases.purpose: Deleting the selected message removes it and moves the selection.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-copy-yanks-the-selected-message
cases.purpose: Copying the selected message puts its text on the kill ring.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-sidebar-viewport-follows-the-chat-selection
cases.purpose: A long chat list renders only the rows around the selection and follows it.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-describe-screen-shows-the-profile
cases.purpose: The profile screen shows the conversation identity and its actions act on the chat.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-message-actions-menu
cases.purpose: The message action menu opens for the selected message and returns to the conversation.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-media-and-link-messages-show-extras
cases.purpose: Photo and link messages render their placeholder lines.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-important-and-online-filters
cases.purpose: The importance and online filters narrow the chat list by mentions and presence.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-filter-tabs-switch-the-list
cases.purpose: Filter tabs narrow the chat list without leaving the client buffer.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-viewport-scrolls-and-pages-the-history
cases.purpose: The message viewport shows the newest rows, scrolls to older ones and pages at the top.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-load-more-prepends-older-history
cases.purpose: Loading an older page prepends it before the loaded history and keeps the selection.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-day-separators-group-messages
cases.purpose: Messages from different days are drawn under their day labels.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-opening-a-chat-reads-its-newest-page
cases.purpose: Opening a chat accepts its newest page as read.

cases.name: etaf-telega-tests-chat-actions-update-the-stored-chat
cases.purpose: The chat actions set the read state and toggle pin and mute.
